notes.title: Non - VR Mode!
notes.content:
After several headaches and upsets, SMN7 now does not require VR to experience!

DMN7 supports both keyboard and mouse as well as controller thanks to Steam Input, also allowing users with the Steam Deck to play in Non VR! 

Other Major Changes include...

- Overall Optimization and Level Separation
- Bug Issues in --REDACTED-- Area
- Other general bug fixes!
